summary: Processes child widgets of a UI widget: reads the input/cursor position pair via DualFieldRead, dispatches on the state returned by ShortComputation_6720 through the jump table at 0x00490538. For states 0-2 it dispatches vtable+64 with argument 0 and runs VTableDispatchListIteration. For states 3-5 it also dispatches vtable+64 with argument 0, then, if the child count at this+0xEC is positive, walks the child linked list from the head at this+0xE0 following next pointers at node+4, and for the child whose rectangle contains the input position dispatches vtable+64 with argument 4 (hit notification). The default path and the end of iteration dispatch VTableDispatchListIteration and return 0.

operations.description: Initialize the two stack locals v8 and v7 to 0 before reading the input position.
Call DualFieldRead(&v8, &v7) to read the input/cursor position pair used for the bounds test.
Call ShortComputation_6720(this) to obtain the state value that selects the switch case.
Switch dispatch over the computed state via the jump table jpt_490489 at global 0x00490538, with cases 0-5 handled explicitly and everything else falling to the default path.
For cases 0-2: dispatch vtable entry at obj+0x40 (vtable+64) with argument 0.
For cases 0-2: call VTableDispatchListIteration(this) and return 0.
For cases 3-5: dispatch vtable entry at obj+0x40 (vtable+64) with argument 0 before iterating children.
Guard: when the child count at this+0xEC is less than or equal to 0 the child iteration is skipped and control jumps to the default path.
Iterate child index v3 from 0 up to the child count at this+0xEC, continuing while v3 stays within [0, count).
Load v5 = this[56], the head of the child widget linked list at offset this+0xE0.
Walk the child linked list by following the next pointer at node+4 (base *(this+0xE4), offset 0x4) until the indexed child is reached.
Guard: the selected child node pointer v6 must be non-null before the rectangle test runs.
Call RectangleBoundsCheck(v6, v8, v7) to test whether the input position falls within the child's bounding rectangle.
On a rectangle hit: dispatch vtable entry at obj+0x40 (vtable+64) with argument 4 as the child hit notification, then jump to the default path.
Return 0 from the case 0-2 path, the default path, and the end of child iteration.
